summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved watchlists not persisting on re-login  **What I checked (read-only):** `modules/watchlist/schema.ts`, `handlers.ts`, `modules/auth/handlers.ts`, `db/auth.ts`, `client/src/pages/WatchlistPage.tsx`, `client/src/hooks/useAuth.tsx`, `client/src/lib/api.ts`, `client/src/App.tsx`.  **Good news — the core design is sound.** The backend is correctly scoped end to end: `watchlists.user_id` is `NOT NULL`, every route (`GET/POST/PUT/DELETE`) filters by `eq(watchlists.user_id, userId)`, and there's no anonymous/default/local-storage fallback anywhere in the client.
